[ဘရ+တိ]

R:
bhati：ဘတိ （ဣ） （√ဘရ်+တိ）
အခကြေးငွေ။ အခယူ၍ အမှုလုပ်ခြင်း။ ဆေးဖိုးဝါးခ။

DOP: bhati bhaṭi f. [ S. bhṛti], wages; fee; hire; paid working; Abh 530 (~i tu nāriyaṃ nibbiso vetanaṃ mūlaṃ); 1053 (vetane bharaṇe ~ī); Sn 25 (attho ~iyā na vijjati; Pj II 39, 3 : bhaṭiyā ti pi pāṭho); Ja I 402, 30 (ekaṃ dāsiṃ ~iṃ adadamānaṃ sāmikā … rajjuyā paharanti); 475, 27 (paresaṃ ~iṃ katvā kicchena jīvantī ti); II 303, 1 (ahaṃ pubbe bahuṃ ~iṃ labhāmi idāni pana tambulamattaṃ pi na labhāmi, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee omit ~iṃ); III 326, 17 (ahaṃ ~iyā māsakaddhamāsakaṃ saṅgharitvā kicchena mātaraṃ posemi); 444, 25 (kiṃ āgato sī ti vutte tumhākaṃ ghare ~iyā kammakaraṇatthan ti āha); IV 43, 23 (~iṃ vā kasiṃ vā katvā); Dhp-a I 70, 12 (imaṃ jhāpehī ti ~iṃ datvā niyyādetvā pakkamiṃsu); II 131, 8 (ayaṃ te ~ī ti sālīnaṃ catasso nāḷiyo dāpetvā); Ud-a 173, 31 (accharāsambhogasaṅkhātāya ~iyā); Pv-a 161, 20 (ahaṃ tunnavāyo bhadde ~iyā tunnakammaṃ karonto vicarāmi); Mhv 30:42 (~iyā kammakārakā); 34:3 (laddhāya ~iyā); Dhātum 114 (bhaṭa bhatyaṃ); — bhati in Ee at Peṭ 174, 23 is wr for gati; — ifc see takka- ( sv takka 1 ).
